records.name: EtcdStorageVersion3Migration
records.message: Updating from etcd 3.5.25 or older to 3.6 without passing through 4.5.26 or later can cause the 3.6 etcd to attempt to contact old, non-existent members tracked in v2 storage.

records.name: ShortNameImageReferences
records.message: 4.21 will no longer accept short name image references (with no domain specified), and updating might break any workload Pods that depend on those references.

records.name: SigstoreSignatureMirroring
records.message: 4.21 will require Sigstore signatures on quay.io/openshift-release-dev/ocp-release to be present on any mirrors configured for that repository.
